In the background, vibrant yellow and red lottery promotional posters are visible. (2) The scene shifts outdoors where a woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a pink cap and a white lace tank top, stands next to the man on a sidewalk. The setting is a typical urban street with signage and metal roll-up doors. (3) Transitioning to a series of indoor locations, the woman is seen in a living room and then a bathroom, holding a slender spray bottle. She demonstrates the product by spraying it on her arms and face, highlighting the fine mist. (4) The woman is shown on a scooter in an outdoor city environment, wearing a black cap. She uses a tissue to wipe her face, suggesting sweat or heat. (5) Back indoors, she applies the spray to cotton pads and uses them as a wet compress on her face. Detailed close-ups show the spray bottle against a soft-focus background. (6) In the final phase, the man and woman are together in a domestic setting; the man looks at a slip of paper with a look of high-arousal surprise while the woman smiles at the camera, holding the product. Discount text overlays appear on screen.
